description: Local/dev simulation when the Apps Gateway is not in front of the app.

rule.local: Front-end MAY send X-User-Id so you can act as a logged-in user without real login
rule.production: Front-end must NEVER send X-User-Id — gateway injects it and strips client values

devFlagExamples: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' (backend only for tooling — do not trust client identity in prod)
warnings: Never ship dev X-User-Id injection or mock login in production builds
Do not register SPA routes for /auth/** — in production those must be full-page gateway requests
Safest: put mock login on /dev-login and only redirect there when DEV
